(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A catheter system for delivering ultrasonic energy to a treatment site within a body lumen, the catheter comprising: a tubular body having a proximal end, a distal end and an energy delivery section positioned between the proximal end and the distal end; a plurality of ultrasound radiating members positioned within the energy delivery section, the plurality of ultrasound radiating members being allocated into electrical groups comprising more than one ultrasound radiating member; wherein the ultrasound radiating members of one electrical group are spatially interdigitated with the ultrasound radiating members of another electrical group, and wherein the ultrasound radiating members are arranged in a configuration that facilitates independent control of the ultrasound radiating members.

(Currently Amended) Claim 6: A system for treating a patient having pulmonary embolism, the system comprising: a first ultrasound catheter and a second ultrasound catheter, each of the first and the second ultrasound catheter comprising a tubular body having a proximal portion and a distal portion, the distal portion comprising an ultrasound energy delivery section having at least one ultrasound element, the tubular body also including at least one fluid delivery lumen; and a control system connected to and configured to operate both a first elongate inner core and a second elongate inner core of the first and the second ultrasound catheter, respectively.
